meta.title: Delete session
meta.description: Adds a Delete session action to the session context menu. Deleting moves the session off disk into a recoverable trash directory and clears its workspace, pin and archive references, so it disappears from the sidebar and workspace view immediately. Right-click a session, then choose Delete session. The session currently open in the main view is deleted and the app returns to a fresh blank session; a session that is still running is refused until it stops. No confirmation dialog is shown.

menu.running: This session is running and cannot be deleted
error.busy: This session is running; stop it before deleting
